speaker: caller
text: Good morning, I am calling from the technical support team of your internet provider.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh, okay? Is there a problem with my line?

speaker: caller
text: Yes, our system shows your router has been hacked and your computer is sending out viruses.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh no, my son uses that computer for school.

speaker: caller
text: It is very serious. Hackers may already have access to your personal files.

speaker: caller
text: Please turn on your computer and open the web browser. I will guide you to download a support app.

speaker: receiver
text: Okay, I am downloading it. It asks for a code.

speaker: caller
text: Yes, give me the nine-digit code on the screen so I can connect and clean your computer.

speaker: caller
text: Now I can see your screen. The virus has reached your banking. Please log in to your internet banking so I can check.

speaker: caller
text: Yes, we must move your money to a protected account before the hackers take it. Please do it right now.

speaker: caller
text: The cleaning service also costs two hundred dollars. Please pay with gift cards from any convenience store.
